SimpleProduct:14958.meta_description: Make lunchtime extra fun with our personalised Bento Lunch Box. Shop online for speedy delivery.
SimpleProduct:14958.faq:
What age group is this lunch box for?

This lunch box is ideal for kids aged 2+.

Does it fit inside your range of lunch bags?

Yes! It comfortably fits inside our range of lunch bags with plenty of room for other food items or a our drink bottles.

Can I wash the lunch box in my dishwasher?

You can wash your lunch box in the top rack of the dishwasher but for best results we recommend hand washing the lid in warm soapy water to keep the design looking great for years to come.

description.html:
Our personalised kids lunch boxes are a great size for school & daycare and fit perfectly into our matching Lunch Bags.

The lid on this kids lunch box is personalised with a large waterproof, dishwasher friendly label that is scratch proof & fade resistant. It features your kid’s name & a design they’ll love & it can be coordinated with our range of durable Name Labels & School Supplies.

The lunch box also comes with a handy spork and three compartments to fit any combination of your kid’s favourite foods. You can easily wash it in the top rack of the dishwasher or the sink and it will be looking great all year.

Please note: this lunch box is not suitable for use in the microwave.

Bento Lunch Box Size: 21.8cm (8.5") wide x 15.7cm (6.1") high x 6cm (2.3") deep

short_description_right.html:

short_description.html:
Make lunchtime extra fun with our personalised Bento Lunch Box. This rectangle bento-style lunch box contains 3 roomy compartments and is the perfect size for storing sandwiches, snacks and more. Includes a plastic spork to help children easily eat dishes such as salad, rice and pasta.

The lid includes 4 closure clips and is easy for little kids to take off and put back on, perfect for helping kids to become more independent. This lunch box is made from sturdy plastic so it will easily endure the rough and tumble of school life, whilst still looking great!
